status: research-only; physical handoff remains unverified; no calibrated depth budget
study: paired numerical controls and a separate high-history axial return-flux run
paired_method: At the same recorded depth, each deficit is 1 - sum(model chunk exposure)/sum(reference chunk exposure). For differences, delete the same seed chunk from both arms, recompute both pooled ratios and subtract; SEM = sqrt((n-1)/n * sum((leave-one-out differences - their mean)^2)).
uncertainty: All reported errors are delete-one-chunk jackknife SEMs, not admission confidence bounds. The precision run overlaps control streams and is not pooled with them.
resource_metric: GNU time reported MaxRSS is retained verbatim. Coverage of forkserver worker processes was not established; do not interpret it as a worker or allocation peak. Host timings are provenance, not speed comparisons.
warnings: Some completed Python 3.14 jobs emitted semaphore resource_tracker cleanup warnings after writing their result JSON; all scheduler exit codes were zero.
batch_script:
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=pyrite623-study
#SBATCH --partition=cpu
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=4
#SBATCH --mem=12G
#SBATCH --time=00:10:00
#SBATCH --output=/home/aamador/pyrite-issue623/issue623-study-%j.log
set -eu
arm=${1:?study arm required}
cells=2
points=16
step=10
depth=10000
chunks=8
electrons=32
cuts=(--cut-eV 178)
case "$arm" in
  baseline) cuts=(--cut-eV 95 --cut-eV 178) ;;
  step) step=5 ;;
  grid) points=24 ;;
  supercell) cells=3 ;;
  depth) depth=20000 ;;
  precision) chunks=16; electrons=128 ;;
  *) exit 2 ;;
esac
cd /home/aamador/pyrite-issue623
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1
export PYRITE_MC_BACKEND=cpu
study_dir=pyrite-output/research/issue623/study-20261021/$arm
mkdir -p "$study_dir"
test ! -e "$study_dir/result.json"
exec 9<.pyrite-sync.lock
flock -s 9
cp .pyrite-sync "$study_dir/code-identity.txt"
cp "$0" "$study_dir/run.sh"
sha256sum checks/axial_mcwf_return_flux.py > "$study_dir/script-sha256.txt"
/home/aamador/.local/bin/uv run --no-sync --no-default-groups python -c \
  'import sys,numpy; print(sys.version); print("numpy",numpy.__version__)' > "$study_dir/environment.txt"
/usr/bin/time -v -o "$study_dir/resources.txt" \
  /home/aamador/.local/bin/uv run --no-sync --no-default-groups python checks/axial_mcwf_return_flux.py \
  --loss-coupling "${cuts[@]}" --cells "$cells" --points-per-cell "$points" \
  --workers 4 --chunks "$chunks" --electrons-per-chunk "$electrons" \
  --depth-max-ang "$depth" --depth-step-ang 1000 --step-ang "$step" \
  --out "$study_dir/result.json"
